title: Fidelity launches FIDD
description: Fidelity launched Fidelity Digital Dollar for eligible customers, identifying Fidelity Digital Assets, National Association as issuer and stating eligible customers can purchase or redeem FIDD for one U.S. dollar.
notes: Reserve allocation and deployment details are not inferred from the launch announcement.

title: Mosta launches MainUSD
description: Mosta launched MainUSD for eligible U.S. businesses and identified Brale as the stablecoin issuer and supporting infrastructure provider.
notes: Broader public access, reserve allocation and direct redemption terms remain unresolved.

title: Falcon and Anchorage Digital Bank launch fUSD
description: Falcon Finance and Anchorage Digital Bank launched fUSD for institutional use, with Falcon describing Anchorage Digital Bank as issuer and Falcon-funded rewards as a separate holder program.
notes: External rewards are not treated as issuer-native yield.

title: USDsui launches on Sui mainnet
description: Sui announced the mainnet launch of USDsui and identified Bridge, a Stripe company, as issuer.
notes: Reserve composition, direct redemption and exact contract identity remain unresolved.
